'''"Jedi Rocks"''' was a crowd-pleasing [[Music/Legends|song]]<ref name="SWI 67">{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}}</ref> performed and made popular by<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]] band<ref name="And the Band Played On">{{StoryCite|story=And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> [[Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers]]. The song continued to be a hit even when the band was reconfigured into the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]]<ref name="CSWE" /> after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of band leader [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]].<ref name="And the Band Played On" />

==Lyrics==
[[Joh Yowza/Legends|Joh Yowza]], "speaking", "Koo nee tang, na' na' na', ah lawah. Koo nee tang!"

[[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]], "Cha tung ee-ma chay-choo raun ta-nee-ee-choo."

[[Rystáll Sant/Legends|Rystáll Sant]], [[Greeata Jendowanian/Legends|Greeata]] and [[Lyn Me/Legends|Lyn Me]], "Ee-ma chay-choo raun."

Sy Snootles, "Ko-nee nan-kee chong noy khan chay-chee-kum, oooh. Chee ka koo-ja oo pa-pa chee-ka-nang kee hey."

Rystáll, Greeata and Lyn Me, "Chee-ka nang kee hey."

Sy Snootles, "You bang ris-pa ka may wang pee-ya nay. Yeeaa!"

Joh Yowza, "Oo-la-wang choo koo-chee-kee-pa-tie tan-ga ris-pa ta ya lee oh. Yo! Ahhh! Yal-lie!"

Sy Snootles, "Ee-ma tsa-ka-moo nan-kee say yal-lee oo ya see, poe no!"

Rystáll, Greeata and Lyn Me, "Na-too pa."

Sy Snootles, "Chun-kee sal-la ma-na na-too pa."

Rystáll, Greeata and Lyn Me, "Zai ya la."

Joh Yowza, "Hay koo-ma zai ya la."

Rystáll, Greeata and Lyn Me, "Do koo chee."

Sy Snootles, "Hoy hat-chi doo-ka! Whoop! Uh-oh!"

(The rest is an instrumental.)

==Behind the scenes==
{{Listen2|Jedi Rocks.flac|"Jedi Rocks"|A short sample clip}}
"Jedi Rocks" was written by [[Jerry Hey]].

"Jedi Rocks" replaced "[[Lapti Nek/Legends|Lapti Nek]]" for the Special Edition release of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].

The full song is never shown in ''Return of the Jedi''. It is instead interrupted when [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] feeds the dancer [[Oola/Legends|Oola]] to his [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|pet rancor]].

The song can be heard in ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' in Assault Mode.

It can also be heard in Jabba's Palace in ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''.

In the OST version, during the vocal part, the guitar is more audible, and the electric piano is also audible in it, but not audible in the film.
